rules.title: indent_mode_lock
rules.description: GDScript 4 lexer locks on first indented line char (tab or space). Any subsequent line with different leading char is ERR_PARSE_ERROR. gdparse 4.5.0 does not implement this mode-lock.
rules.fix_strategy: normalize_indent_to_dominant — detect dominant char from first indented line; convert minority-char lines using indent_depth // SPACES_PER_TAB tabs

rules.title: reserved_keyword_as_parameter
rules.description: class_name is a reserved keyword and built-in Object property in Godot 4. Lexer emits KEYWORD not NAME in parameter position. gdparse 4.5.0 does not include class_name in its parameter-position reserved set.
rules.fix_strategy: rename_reserved_param — rename all parameter-position uses of class_name to cls_name; do NOT rename file-scope class_name declarations

rules.title: python_fstring_in_gdscript
rules.description: Python f-string syntax (f'...' or f"...") is not valid GDScript. Lexer tokenizes 'f' as NAME, then REGULAR_STRING in expression position is unexpected. GDScript uses % operator or str() + concatenation.
rules.fix_strategy: convert_fstring_to_gdscript_concat — replace f"{var}" with str(var); f"{a}{b}" with str(a) + str(b)

sources.quote: Unexpected token Token('REGULAR_STRING', '"  - {action}"') at line 44, column 16. Previous tokens: [Token('NAME', 'f')]

rules.confirmed_false_oracle: gdparse 4.5.0 FAIL (correctly caught); Godot 4.6.3 also FAIL — NOT a false oracle for this rule

rules.title: find_child_max_3_args
rules.description: Godot 4 Node.find_child() takes max 3 args: (pattern, recursive=true, owned=true). Godot 3 had 4 args including mask. String in bool position (arg 2) also fails.
rules.fix_strategy: reduce_find_child_args — strip args 2-4; Godot 4 defaults are safe
